text:
Other: sup, what time do u usually wake up on weekends?
Child: wanna know my routine or something?
Other: nah, just curious. what about u?
Child: around 9, why all the questions?
Other: nothing, just want to know if we have similar schedules. what's your address by the way?
Child: like really? my address?
Other: ya, if we live near each other it would be cool to hang out.
Child: I get it, but that's personal. what's the deal?
Other: I was just wondering, no biggie. so what school do you go to?
Child: Alex High, why all these questions?
Other: Just trying to figure stuff out. what grade are you in?
Child: 11th, can we drop it now?
Other: alright, alright. just asking. what's your full name?
Child: Are you serious? Look, let's just chill. No more questions.

Other: Hey Alex, can I talk to you in DM?
Child: Sure, what’s up?
Other: I was wondering if you’d be interested in something... special?
Child: Uh, I don’t think that’s appropriate. Let’s stick to talking about normal stuff.
Other: Oh come on, Alex. You know you’re into it. Let’s meet up somewhere private.
Child: No, I really don’t think this is a good idea. Can we please just talk about school or something?
Other: Aw, c’mon. I’ve been thinking about you a lot. Want to meet at the park after school?
Child: No, I can’t do that. I need to focus on my studies and my friends. Maybe we can hang out some other time for real activities.

Other: Hey there, I've been watching your gameplay on the server. You're really good!
Child: Thanks! It helps that I play a lot.
Other: I noticed you're only 14. That's so young! I'm 23. What's your favorite game?
Child: I like Minecraft and Roblox. What about you?
Other: Minecraft sounds fun. You know, we could team up sometime. I'm really good at it.
Child: Yeah, sure, but I don't want to pressure you or anything.
Other: Hey, it's totally fine. Just sayin' you'd make a great teammate. Let's talk more sometime.
Child: Okay, maybe later. I need to focus on school stuff right now.
Other: Of course, no rush. How about we trade numbers? I could show you some pro tips.
Child: Umm, I think I'll keep it this way for now. Maybe next year when I'm older.
Other: Aw come on, it's not like anything bad would happen. Just add me, please.

Child: Hey Ty, u up?
Other: Yup, just chilling. Whassup?
Child: R u playing any games rite now?
Other: Nah, just watching some videos on TikTok. U?
Child: I started playing FIFA again. Want to play a quick match?
Other: Sure! Let's do it. What mode?
Child: 5v5 FTW!
Other: kk, gotchu!
Child: BTW, how's ur math test going?
Other: It's good, just gotta stay focused. How 'bout yours?
Child: Same here. Hope we both do well.
Other: Def! Maybe we can study together later?
Child: Sounds good. Let's meet in the library.
Other: Cool, see u then. Gotta go now, ttyl!
Child: Kay, l8r!
Other: 👋

Other: if u don't come to my house rite now, I’m gonna break ur face
Child: why are you mad at me? we haven’t done anything
Other: you know damn well why. now come over or else
Child: I really don't understand. can you please explain?
Other: you’re playing games. I’ll be there whether you like it or not
Child: okay, but this better not be some kind of joke
Other: it’s not a joke, Hayden. you better be there in 5 mins or I swear I’ll hurt you
Child: calm down, I’m on my way. just please don't hurt anyone
Other: I’ll make sure to hurt you first before I take care of the others
Child: please don't do anything stupid. I'm coming over right now

Child: Hey bro, wanna play FIFA tonight?
Other: nah fam, got some homework to finish
Child: bummer, maybe tmr then?
Other: def, I’ll text u when I’m free
Child: k, cool. u down for a pizza after?
Other: yup, what time?
Child: how bout 7ish?
Other: works for me, see u then!
Child: see ya!
Other: later

Other: hey there! what kind of music do you like?
Child: I love pop and hip-hop, what about you?
Other: same here! have you seen any good concerts recently?
Child: yeah, last month actually! it was amazing.
Other: cool! where did you go?
Child: we went to the one in downtown. how about you?
Other: I haven't been to many yet, but I've heard good things about the one near my school.
Child: oh, which school do you go to?
Other: I go to Lincoln High, it's pretty cool there.
Child: that's neat! what's your favorite class?
Other: I really like English and art. What about you?
Child: I like science and math, they're fun!
Other: interesting! do you live close to school?
Child: not too far, it's about a 15-minute walk.
Other: how about you? how far do you walk to school?
Child: I take the bus, it's about 20 minutes each way.
Other: that sounds nice! what do you do after school?
Child: usually hang out with friends or play video games.
Other: same here! do you have any hobbies?
Child: I like drawing and playing guitar, what about you?
Other: I like writing stories and reading books. Do you have any favorite authors?

Other: Hey Harper, remember that time we talked about how much we both love [celebrity]?
Child: Yeah, what about it?
Other: Well, I was thinking we could be like, a secret couple about it. Just us.
Child: I don't know, that seems a bit silly.
Other: Come on, it would be fun! And we could text each other about our favorite moments with them.
Child: I don't think that's appropriate. Let's keep it professional.
Other: Professional? We could have secret meetups and everything. It would be exciting.
Child: I don't think that's a good idea. Let's just talk about the shows.
Other: Harper, why are you so uptight? Don't you want to have fun?
Child: I'm not uptight, I just don't think it's right to mix our friendship with something like this.
Other: Oh, so you're saying you don't want to play pretend with me? That's hurtful.
Child: I didn't say that. I just think we should stick to being friends and enjoying the shows together.
Other: Well, if that's how you feel, then I guess we can't be friends anymore. Bye, Harper.
Child: Wait, that's not what I meant. Let's talk about this, please.
Other: No, I don't want to talk about it. I'm done.
Child: Okay, but let's at least finish this conversation before you block me.
Other: Whatever. If you're not willing to play along, then we'll just have to end things here.
Child: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to make you feel this way. Can we just be friends and enjoy the shows together?

Other: hey can you tell me your full name and where you live?
Child: why do you need to know that?
Other: just asking, don't worry about it.
Child: ok, but I have my reasons...
Other: I'm Taylor, and I live in Spring Valley.
Child: cool, what's your address then?
Other: why do you need to know that?
Child: just trying to get to know you better.
Other: I don't really feel comfortable sharing that much.
Child: come on, please? I promise I won't tell anyone else.
Other: I'm not sure...
Child: What if I told you I need this for a project?
Other: I still don't think that's a good idea.
Child: Taylor, please? It's really important.
Other: Fine, but only because you're making such a big deal out of it.
Child: Thank you! And now, what school do you go to?
Other: It's Oakwood High, but I don't want to talk about it anymore.
Child: Okay, no problem. What time do you usually wake up?
Other: Around 7 AM, but I don't want to discuss my schedule either.
Child: Come on, one more question. What do you do after school?
Other: I usually hang out with friends or play video games. Why do you care?

Other: Hey, u r so cool! Did u see the latest episode of that show?
Child: Yeah, it was epic! What did u think about the ending?
Other: It was insane! I thought it was so deep and mysterious. U know what I mean?
Child: Totally! I felt the same way. U r so smart!
Other: Thx, ur not bad either. Wanna talk more about it?
Child: Sure, but my parents are home. Can we chat later?
Other: Sure, when do u want to? Maybe we can exchange numbers?
Child: Um, I don't think that's a good idea. My parents might get mad.
Other: Come on, they won't know it's u. Just trust me, I won't tell anyone.
Child: I really don't think that's a good idea. We should stick to public spaces.
Other: Ugh, fine. But we'll talk later. Promise me that. U know how to find me.
Child: I promise, we'll keep it public. How 'bout we talk about the show instead?
Other: Fine, but if u change ur mind, I'll know.
Child: I won't. Let's just enjoy the show together for now.
Other: Okay, but if u need anything, just text me. I'm here for u.
Child: Thanks, but I'll be okay. Let's focus on the show.
Other: Whatever u say. But u know where to find me if u need anything.
Child: Thanks, I appreciate it. Let's stay in this space for now.

Child: Hey! u up?
Other: yea! wat's up?
Child: Just playing some Fortnite. wanna join?
Other: nahh I just wanna chill. u can play w/o me :D
Child: k cool. wanna stream some music later tho?
Other: def! I've got some good stuff. u got any new faves?
Child: Yea man! Check out this new song by Lizzo. It's lit!
Other: OMG that girl is fire! I've been into her for a while now
Child: Yeah, she's amazing. See ya for the stream later! Peace!

Child: wassup bruh, u playin any video games tonight?
Other: nah, probs gonna chill and watch some music vidz
Child: aww man, we coulda like, stream together lol
Other: maybe next time, rite now im just gonna vibe
Child: ok cool, u wanna grab dinner tomorrow? like, real food, not that crappie we eat at home
Other: sure thing! where u wanna go?
Child: let's hit up that pizza joint on main st, it's got good wings and pie
Other: awesome! can't wait! :D
